As Suncor Energy (SU) Stock Value Declined, Burgundy Asset Management LTD Lowered Its Position by $55.77 Million; Oclaro (OCLR) Position Boosted by Quentec Asset Management Llc
May 21, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Quentec Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Oclaro Inc (OCLR) by 30.12% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Quentec Asset Management Llc bought 268,459 shares as the company’s stock rose 40.76% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 1.16M shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.82 million, up from 891,170 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Quentec Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Oclaro Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.51B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.11% or $0.01 during the last trading session, reaching $8.88. About 1.57M shares traded. Oclaro, Inc. (NASDAQ:OCLR) has declined 2.03% since May 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 13.58% the S&P500.
Burgundy Asset Management Ltd decreased its stake in Suncor Energy Inc. (SU) by 43.8% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Burgundy Asset Management Ltd sold 1.55 million shares as the company’s stock declined 2.02% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.99 million shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $73.11 million, down from 3.54 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Burgundy Asset Management Ltd who had been investing in Suncor Energy Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $66.97 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.06% or $0.44 during the last trading session, reaching $40.97. About 3.12M shares traded. Suncor Energy Inc. (NYSE:SU) has risen 13.82% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 2.27% the S&P500.
Burgundy Asset Management Ltd, which manages about $19.85 billion and $11.00 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. (NYSE:AJG) by 28,426 shares to 1.49M shares, valued at $94.60 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3,802 shares in the quarter, for a total of 1.07 million shares, and has risen its stake in Extended Stay America Inc. (NYSE:STAY).
Among 16 analysts covering Suncor Energy Inc. ( NYSE:SU ), 15 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 94% are positive. Suncor Energy Inc. had 34 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. On Friday, October 30 the stock rating was upgraded by National Bank Canada to “Outperform”. Morgan Stanley maintained it with “Overweight” rating and $54 target in Monday, April 16 report. Edward Jones upgraded the stock to “Buy” rating in Tuesday, November 21 report. The company was initiated on Friday, August 19 by Bank of America. Piper Jaffray maintained it with “Buy” rating and $46.0 target in Friday, February 9 report. Citigroup downgraded Suncor Energy Inc. (NYSE:SU) on Wednesday, April 20 to “Neutral” rating. The firm has “Buy” rating by Bank of America given on Thursday, April 5. The firm earned “Hold” rating on Wednesday, November 18 by TD Securities. The firm earned “Outperform” rating on Friday, December 16 by Wells Fargo. As per Thursday, January 11, the company rating was maintained by Piper Jaffray.
Analysts await Suncor Energy Inc. (NYSE:SU) to report earnings on July, 25. They expect $0.47 EPS, up 422.22% or $0.38 from last year’s $0.09 per share. SU’s profit will be $768.29M for 21.79 P/E if the $0.47 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.48 actual EPS reported by Suncor Energy Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -2.08% negative EPS growth.

It also reduced its holding in Lumentum Hldgs Inc (Call) by 2.36M shares in the quarter, leaving it with 498,300 shares, and cut its stake in Red Hat Inc (Put) (NYSE:RHT).
